summary: Auto-close Closes/Fixes/Resolves issues when PRs merge to release* or epic/* integration branches (#427); keep status:implemented labeling; skip Epic/Task/Release; pure helpers + audit comment marker.
migration_impact: Workflows that merge to release/epic/* will close linked Feature/Bug/Doc issues after merge (not only on main). Epic/Task/Release issues stay open. main behavior unchanged (native GitHub close).
migration_guidance: 2. Prefer Closes #N in PR bodies targeting release; issues close via CI with PLATE-INTEGRATION-CLOSE marker.
3. Do not put Closes on Epic/Task/Release when the work is only a partial slice — use Related to #N or omit keyword.
4. main Release PRs still rely on native GitHub auto-close.
agent_notes: Helpers in plate_core.integration_close for tests/reuse. Workflow owns live close (permissions). Complements #556 status:implemented. Addresses stuck open issues after release merges.
